It changed no production code or tests. This is not the full test claim for the later parser/guidance changes.

limitations: One executable upstream lineage does not demonstrate seven-area device breadth.
UART-over-TCP does not establish physical transport, timing, electrical behavior or throughput.
The 50 ms guidance is a tested emulator margin, not an exact-delay acceptance requirement.
Evaluator qualification identity still spans all benchmark_support code; follow-up scope work is tracked locally.
